title: Understanding Offer — payload
description: A joining party consensually offers its address and intent; the host answers with the digest-pinned gateway terms document.

endpoint.description: The offered address the joiner answers at. Offered, never discovered — offering is the consent.

intent.description: One line: what the joiner wants of the room.

uri.description: Where the terms document is served.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the terms document; pins exactly which terms this join reads.

gateway.description: The gateway: the terms document whose comprehension is the key.

exchangeBy.description: Deadline for the exchange step; the pending join lapses after it.
